strings.name: Joni Mitchell
strings.summary: Mitchell emerged from Canadian folk music, developing personal lyrics, alternate guitar tunings and intricate harmony. Blue, Court and Spark and Hejira cross folk, pop and jazz boundaries. She also paints and designs record artwork. After a 2015 brain aneurysm, rehabilitation led to a stage return; late performances and archival albums continue her creative influence.
